command: Neurospora crassa GLT-1 (NCU01633; Q1K4S3) retains carbohydrate-proton symport and proton transmembrane transport in addition to its established low-affinity glucose uptake. Evaluate against actual GO definitions, primary uptake/energetics measurements, and historical system-I assignment. PMID28115989 directly measures radioglucose kinetics and maps GLT-1 to historical system I; its Discussion distinguishes system-I diffusion from system-II proton coupling. Does the identification establish absence of proton coupling, or infer it from affinity/expression and earlier whole-cell work? Read relevant historical primary experiments, assay design and protein-specific evidence. Current PTHR48022 target leaf PTN002362095 is a descendant of the actual PTN000627328 IBD for GO0005351; there is no lineage loss row in the recovered path. Low affinity does not itself imply passive transport and absence of a target experiment alone does not invalidate ancestry. Distinguish glucose specificity from coupling mechanism.
